question: ‘My Country My life’, is the autobiography of which of the following ex - Deputy Prime Minister of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lal Krishna Advani** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• My Country My Life is an autobiographical book by** L. K. Advani, **an Indian politician who served as the **Deputy Prime Minister of India.**
 
• The book was released on **19 March 2008 by Abdul Kalam, the eleventh President of India.**
 
• The book has 1,040 pages and narrates autobiographical** accounts and events in the life of Advani**.
 
• It became the best-seller book in non-fiction. The book alongside mentions the event in Indian politics and India's history from 1900 till date.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9948f3c6ef487c96d323949e3b7733a1108ba915baadda863b5338e8bd16e768.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Advani is one of the co-founders and a senior leader of the** Bharatiya Janata Party**. He is a longtime member of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh
 
• **One Life Is Not Enough** is an autobiography by** K. Natwar Singh, former Minister of External Affairs **and senior Indian National Congress politician.
 
• India's best known boxer, five times World Champion and an Olympic medallist,** Mary Kom t**ells the moving and inspiring story of her life with surprising honesty in her book** Unbreakable.**
